title: Diagnosis of Depth of Submucosal Invasion in Colorectal Cancer with AI Using Deep Learning.
summary: CNN trained on 706 endoscopic images/91 patients, evaluated on separate 394-image/49-patient set and prospective 56-patient test against pathology/endoscopists; retrospective sensitivity/specificity are imbalanced (87.2%/35.7%), so the result is a narrow diagnostic proof.
